## About me 
I'm a Reader in the 
[Statistics and Probability Group](http://www.york.ac.uk/maths/research/statistics-probability) 
in the [Department of Mathematics](http://maths.york.ac.uk/www/Home) at the [University of York](http://www.york.ac.uk), UK.

***

### {{< iconify streamline:dice-5-remix>}}&nbsp; Research

My research interests are primarily in applied probability. In particular:

  - mixing times of Markov chains
  - perfect simulation
  - coupling theory
  - interacting particle systems.
  
{{< iconify mdi:arrow-right-bottom>}} Here are a list of my [publications](publications.qmd) and some selected [talks](talks.qmd).

***

### {{< iconify system-uicons:speech-bubble>}}&nbsp; Outreach

I regularly run [outreach sessions](outreach.qmd) at local schools, and from 2017 - 2020 I was a London Mathematical Society [Holgate Session Leader](https://www.lms.ac.uk/events/lectures/holgate-lectures-and-workshops).

***

### {{< iconify vaadin:exit>}}&nbsp; External

  - I co-founded the [Probability in the North East (PiNE)](https://www.maths.dur.ac.uk/PiNE/) research network
  - I'm an editor for the [Applied Probability Trust journals](https://www.appliedprobability.org/home)
  - I'm a member of the Research Grants Committee of the [London Mathematical Society](https://www.lms.ac.uk)
  - From 2020 - 2024 I was an external member of the Academic Steering and Management Group for the [Scottish Mathematical Sciences Training Centre](https://smstc.ac.uk)
  - For most of 2009 - 2019 I was a lecturer of the Applied Stochastic Processes module for the [Academy for PhD Training in Statistics (APTS](http://apts.ac.uk)
